about: Brewery logo library for the Garth's Brew Bar draft board. One entry per brewery. group 'draft' = on the Kegs tab or poured on draft since Jun 2025, named as typed on the Kegs tab; group 'menu history' = everything else ever on the Untappd menu (draft or cooler), named as on Untappd. When two names collide, 'draft' entries win. Files live in breweries/, untouched originals in originals/.
